name: smwgraphics-jelectro
title: Jelectro
description:
A Jelectro from SMB3 that I drew myself which replaces Munchers. It flashes its outline black to grey which gives it a really nice flashing/electric effect. Change it to palette 0x4 on Map 16 for it to look correct.

Requested by Goombakid47. Also my first graphics submission.

Oh yeah, credit isn't necessary since I spent like 3 minutes on this, but it would be to my liking.
